title: Watching a Movie
description: You have n intervals representing best moments of a movie. You may skip exactly x minutes at a time. Determine the minimum number of minutes you must actually watch to cover all intervals.
input_format: First line: n, x. Next n lines: two integers l_i and r_i for each interval.
output_format: Print a single integer — the minimum total minutes watched.
expected_approach: Greedy: for each segment, if the gap from current time to start of segment ≥ x, skip via the skip button; else, watch minute-by-minute, adding (r_i — l_i + 1) to your total, and update current time to r_i + 1.

test_cases.explanation: Skip to minute 4, watch minutes 5–6 (2 mins), skip to 9, watch 10–12 (3 mins), total 6.
No beneficial skips available; must watch all minutes.
